Title: Database target safety
Preconditions: Use local disposable, Docker, non-test, remote and unsupported-scheme URIs; clear TEST_MONGODB_URI for the missing-value case.
Steps: Call URI validation and configuration helpers for each fixture.
Expected: Accept allowed disposable targets; reject unsafe/missing targets before connecting; never fall back to MONGODB_URI.

Title: Admin request validation
Preconditions: Default/bounded page inputs; supported user/listing filters; invalid status.
Steps: Parse query schemas with valid and invalid fixtures.
Expected: Defaults and valid filters parse; unsupported values fail validation.

Title: Dealer application validation
Preconditions: Multipart field strings; incomplete application; missing rejection reason.
Steps: Parse application and review schemas.
Expected: Normalize form values; reject missing required application data and absent rejection reason.

Title: CSV upload validation
Preconditions: Category headers for cars and motorcycles; missing headers; binary/non-CSV files; invalid paging.
Steps: Validate file/header fixtures and pagination schemas.
Expected: Accept matching category headers; reject unsupported content and missing fields; bound history/rejection pagination.

Title: Listing validation and identity
Preconditions: Plate formatting variants, pagination bounds, inverted filters, empty edits, image ordering, petrol/electric/category fixtures.
Steps: Normalize registration values and parse listing schemas.
Expected: Equivalent plates share identity; invalid edits/ranges/category attributes fail; valid petrol listing parses.

Title: Image signature validation
Preconditions: JPEG, PNG and WebP headers; spoofed JPEG and unsupported GIF.
Steps: Call hasValidImageSignature for each fixture.
Expected: Supported signatures accepted; spoofed or unsupported content rejected. This does not prove complete image decoding.

Title: Search query and embedding helpers
Preconditions: “automatic SUV under 2 million near Colombo”; “toyata corola”; mileage/year query; oversized query; vector fixture.
Steps: Analyze queries, validate request bounds and normalize embeddings.
Expected: Expected structured fields/typo corrections; bounded input; local vector length 384 and normalized magnitude.

Title: Pagination metadata
Preconditions: Partial final page and empty collection.
Steps: Calculate pagination metadata for both fixtures.
Expected: Correct final page counts; zero total pages for an empty collection.

Title: CSV extraction
Preconditions: Readable CSV stream with multiple batches; malformed row width.
Steps: Consume extraction output and record batch/progress callbacks.
Expected: Bounded batches and cumulative progress; malformed column counts fail.

Title: Vehicle normalization
Preconditions: Whitespace/enums/numbers/price suffixes; optional blanks; motorcycle fields.
Steps: Normalize each row for the selected category.
Expected: Consistent values and category-specific attributes; optional blanks remain unset.

Title: Batch transformation
Preconditions: Mixed valid/invalid rows and electric-car row with battery details.
Steps: Run prepareInventoryBatch with a known starting CSV row number.
Expected: Keep valid rows; isolate invalid rows with original row numbers; retain electric attributes.

Title: Category and powertrain rules
Preconditions: Petrol/diesel/hybrid/electric/plug-in hybrid cars and the other five supported categories.
Steps: Validate valid and missing/invalid required attribute combinations.
Expected: Accept valid categories; require engine or battery data as appropriate; return field-level failures.

Title: ZIP image orchestration
Preconditions: Mock repositories/storage; ZIP paths with slash/backslash; unknown folder; root file; existing image count; download failure.
Steps: Run image processor with mocked boundaries and inspect calls/results.
Expected: Match normalized plates; report unmatched folders; skip unsupported entries; respect configured image capacity; record download failure.

Title: CSV ETL orchestration
Preconditions: Mock storage and repositories; valid+invalid rows; malformed CSV; duplicate registration.
Steps: Run extractInventoryUpload and inspect persistence/status calls and counters.
Expected: Mixed file returns 2 processed, 1 valid, 1 rejected, 0 duplicate; malformed file fails; duplicate goes to rejection path.

Title: Dealer repository persistence
Preconditions: Empty test database; valid application fixture.
Steps: 1. Create a dealer application. 2. Retrieve it by user ID. 3. Inspect stored state.
Expected: One matching application with pending status and expected fields.

Title: Admin pending-application order
Preconditions: Empty test database; A Motors and B Motors applications.
Steps: 1. Create A then B. 2. List pending applications.
Expected: Both pending applications returned in creation order.

Title: Registration lookup against MongoDB
Preconditions: Active and archived normalized-plate fixtures.
Steps: 1. Look up alternate plate formatting. 2. Query archived-only plate. 3. Exclude current listing ID. 4. Query another plate.
Expected: Active match found; archived/self/different-plate cases do not incorrectly block. This lookup suite alone does not prove atomic concurrent uniqueness.

Title: Identity synchronization and route authorization
Preconditions: Real test Firebase token or configured emulator; buyer, dealer A/B, admin and suspended user.
Steps: 1. Call /api/v1/auth/me twice. 2. Call dealer/admin routes with each role. 3. Repeat without/with invalid token. 4. Substitute dealer B listing ID as A.
Expected: One local profile per UID; allowed routes succeed; unauthorized calls deny access and cause no writes.
Evidence: Implement HTTP integration harness; record response and database evidence

Title: Approval transaction and audit
Preconditions: Pending application; admin identity; replica set.
Steps: 1. Approve application. 2. Inspect dealer, user role and audit. 3. Repeat review. 4. Inject failure inside review transaction.
Expected: Dealer status and user role change together with a review audit; duplicate review is controlled; rollback leaves no partial approval.
Evidence: HTTP responses plus before/after database snapshot

Title: Listing lifecycle and ownership
Preconditions: Approved dealer A/B; valid car fixture.
Steps: 1. Create draft as A. 2. Edit description/price. 3. Publish. 4. Mark sold/archive. 5. Attempt edits as B. 6. Inspect public browse at each state.
Expected: Edits persist, ownership remains A, only eligible active listings appear publicly, foreign modifications fail.

Title: Image storage and metadata consistency
Preconditions: Dealer-owned listing; real test bucket; valid PNG and spoofed file.
Steps: 1. Upload valid image. 2. Fetch public image. 3. Remove image. 4. Try spoofed/oversize image. 5. Inject metadata failure after storage write.
Expected: Stored content and metadata agree; removed image is no longer exposed; invalid uploads fail; no unreconciled orphan remains after recovery.
Evidence: Object listing, metadata, HTTP response and image evidence

Title: CSV API to queue to worker
Preconditions: Real MongoDB/Redis/storage; approved dealer; fixture: one valid, one invalid and one active duplicate row.
Steps: 1. Submit CSV. 2. Capture upload ID and stored original. 3. Observe queue and worker. 4. Poll terminal state. 5. Query listings/rejections.
Expected: Accepted request creates a job linked to the dealer; 3 processed, 1 valid, 1 invalid rejection, 1 duplicate; final completedWithErrors; rejected rows retain source identity.
Evidence: Job events, preserved CSV, DB counters and rejected rows

Title: ZIP processing across real services
Preconditions: Completed CSV import; ZIP contains matching plate folders and UNKNOWN-9999.
Steps: 1. Submit ZIP for that upload. 2. Wait for image completion. 3. Inspect listing photos and unmatched folders. 4. Attempt as another dealer.
Expected: Only that upload’s matching listings receive photos; unmatched folder reported; foreign access denied; photos render from storage.
Evidence: ZIP, upload result, object metadata and listing view

Title: Search service and database retrieval
Preconditions: Known catalogue including an older exact match among more than 300 records; fixed embedding mode.
Steps: 1. Filter by category/price/location. 2. Submit natural-language and typo queries. 3. Switch sort and page. 4. Disable provider.
Expected: Hard constraints hold across sort/page; known relevant matches are retrievable; fallback returns usable results without a server error. Judge ranked results against a pre-labelled query set.
Evidence: Seed manifest, result IDs, provider mode and timings

Title: Notifications, ownership and SMTP failure
Preconditions: Dealer A/B, admin, local mail sink or test inbox; completion/failure/review events.
Steps: 1. Trigger events. 2. Check recipient/unread state. 3. Mark read. 4. Attempt foreign notification read. 5. Cause SMTP failure.
Expected: Correct owner receives in-app summary; read count updates; foreign access denied; SMTP failure retains in-app notification and records failed email state. Resolve completion-email policy discrepancy before sign-off.
Evidence: Notification documents, API responses and captured mail

Title: Moderation and statistics
Preconditions: Admin; active/suspended users; 250 dealer listings with known status distribution.
Steps: 1. Suspend/reactivate a user. 2. Archive a listing. 3. Query dashboard totals and paged inventory. 4. Inspect audit.
Expected: Suspension blocks protected operations; moderation persists; totals cover all 250 records; pages expose full inventory; actor/time/resource audit exists.
Evidence: Counts, audit rows and access-control responses

Title: Concurrent duplicate creation
Preconditions: Two simultaneous API/import requests using CAX-1234 and cax 1234.
Steps: 1. Synchronize submission of both requests. 2. Repeat with manual create plus CSV import. 3. Inspect normalized active/draft identity.
Expected: At most one reserving listing is created; conflicting request is reported as conflict or duplicate rejection; no silent double insertion.
Evidence: Concurrent request log and database aggregation

Title: Worker restart and replay
Preconditions: Multi-batch CSV; isolated worker and real dependencies.
Steps: 1. Stop worker after a persisted batch. 2. Restart before lease expiry; observe queue result. 3. Repeat after lease expiry. 4. Replay a completed job.
Expected: Abandoned work eventually resumes; no job is falsely acknowledged as complete; no duplicate rows; final counts match the original source.
Evidence: Worker/queue timeline, lease values and unique row counts

Title: Dependency health and recovery
Preconditions: Dedicated running test stack; no shared/demo services.
Steps: 1. Check live/ready endpoints. 2. Disconnect test database. 3. Observe readiness and logs. 4. Restore database.
Expected: Liveness describes process health; readiness returns 503 when database is unavailable and returns ready after recovery; logs diagnose failure without secrets. Queue/worker diagnostics are separately assessed.
Evidence: Timestamped health responses and sanitized logs

Title: Transient failures and lost queue publication
Preconditions: Test storage/Redis fault injection; accepted upload record.
Steps: 1. Fail storage download temporarily and restore it. 2. Fail queue publication after MongoDB job creation. 3. Inspect retry/reconciliation behavior.
Expected: Recoverable work is retried or exposed for explicit recovery; no permanently invisible pending job; terminal failure has meaningful cause.
Evidence: Durable job state, queue state, attempts and recovery timeline

Title: Buyer registration and sign-in
Preconditions: Unused test email and existing buyer; test Firebase project.
Steps: 1. Register with missing fields and mismatched passwords. 2. Register valid buyer. 3. Sign out/in. 4. Try wrong password and duplicate email. 5. Refresh protected page.
Expected: Clear validation/authentication errors; one identity/profile for valid account; session and navigation behave correctly; no duplicate local account.

Title: Dealer application and approval
Preconditions: Test applicant, documents and separate admin session.
Steps: 1. Complete dealer registration/application. 2. Verify pending access restrictions. 3. Admin views documents and approves. 4. Applicant refreshes/signs in again.
Expected: Pending application visible to admin; approval grants dealer portal and creates audit/notification; documents remain protected.

Title: Application rejection and correction
Preconditions: Pending applicant and admin.
Steps: 1. Reject with reason. 2. Applicant reads rejection. 3. Attempt correction/resubmission.
Expected: Required rejection reason is visible and dealer access remains denied. Correction/resubmission is a proposed enhancement, currently blocked by existing-application check; report separately from mandatory rejection behavior.

Title: Create, edit and publish a vehicle
Preconditions: Approved dealer; unique valid car; two valid images; separate buyer session.
Steps: 1. Create draft with photos. 2. Edit price and description. 3. Publish. 4. Buyer opens details. 5. Dealer removes one photo. 6. Buyer refreshes.
Expected: Saved edits, correct dealer details and photos are visible; draft is not publicly browsable; removed image no longer appears.

Title: Recover from partial photo failure
Preconditions: New vehicle; force second image request to fail after listing and first image save.
Steps: 1. Submit form. 2. Observe failure. 3. Restore image service. 4. Retry using the visible workflow. 5. Inspect listings and photos.
Expected: Exactly one listing remains; first image is not duplicated; missing image can be added without registration conflict; error clearly explains recovery. Known code-review risk: resubmit can call create again.

Title: Bulk import, corrections and ZIP photos
Preconditions: CSV with valid, invalid and duplicate rows; ZIP with matching and unmatched folders.
Steps: 1. Download category template. 2. Upload mixed CSV. 3. Observe status/counters. 4. Read rejection reasons. 5. Correct and upload only rejected valid candidates. 6. Attach ZIP. 7. Inspect vehicle photos.
Expected: Valid rows appear once; errors explain correction; original successful rows are not accidentally duplicated; unmatched folders visible; summary and notifications agree.

Title: Buyer discovery and dealer contact
Preconditions: Seeded catalogue with known automatic SUV below LKR 2 million in Colombo plus distractors.
Steps: 1. Browse marketplace. 2. Combine filters and natural-language query. 3. Try toyata corola. 4. Change sort/page. 5. Open details and dealer contact. 6. Try no-match query.
Expected: Relevant fixtures appear while hard constraints hold; details match selected vehicle/dealer; pagination works; empty results have clear feedback.

Title: Inventory actions and large inventory
Preconditions: Dealer with 250 seeded listings; known status counts.
Steps: 1. Search and paginate inventory. 2. Publish draft. 3. Mark sold and archive. 4. Simulate one failed action. 5. Inspect counts and buyer results.
Expected: All inventory is reachable; successful changes update counters; failed action shows feedback and preserves state; sold/archived listings leave active buyer results.

Title: Administrator moderation and suspension
Preconditions: Admin and active dealer in separate sessions.
Steps: 1. Find dealer/user. 2. Suspend account. 3. Dealer attempts protected action. 4. Reactivate. 5. Archive listing. 6. Review audit and dashboard.
Expected: Suspension is enforced by backend; reactivation restores allowed access; archive is visible; audit identifies actor/resource/action; unauthorized admin navigation is denied.

Title: Notification centre and delivery status
Preconditions: Admin/dealer sessions, captured test email and generated review/import events.
Steps: 1. Trigger approval and failed import. 2. Observe bell/count. 3. Open and mark read. 4. Reload. 5. Check delivery status and other user’s inbox.
Expected: Correct recipient sees accurate persisted summary/read state; email status reflects delivery attempt; other inbox is isolated. Successful-import email expectation remains a documented SRS-policy decision.

Title: Responsive, keyboard and failure states
Preconditions: Desktop, tablet and mobile viewports; browser keyboard access.
Steps: 1. Complete search and listing form at each viewport. 2. Navigate using Tab/Enter/Escape. 3. Trigger loading, empty and network-failure states. 4. Reload nested route.
Expected: No essential clipped controls; forms have labels and useful errors; visible focus; pending actions controlled; nested route reload works.

Title: Dealer public-profile update
Preconditions: Approved dealer and buyer session.
Steps: 1. Locate dealer profile edit. 2. Change public phone/address/description. 3. Save. 4. Buyer refreshes listing dealer details.
Expected: Authorized edits persist and public details update. Current route inspection found no dealer profile-update endpoint; treat as an implementation gap pending remediation, not a passed journey.

Title: API and search response time
Preconditions: Known catalogue; defined expected-load stage; fixed provider configuration.
Steps: 1. Warm up 2 minutes. 2. Run normal API and structured/semantic search requests for 10 minutes. 3. Repeat three runs. 4. Save per-request durations and errors.
Expected: Normal API p95 ≤2 seconds; structured search ≤2 seconds under expected conditions; semantic search normally ≤5 seconds, with provider exceptions identified, not hidden.

Title: 5,000-row ETL throughput
Preconditions: 5,000 unique valid rows; recorded CPU/RAM, batch size and embedding/enrichment mode.
Steps: 1. Submit import. 2. Time accepted upload to final persisted completion. 3. Browse/search concurrently. 4. Count records.
Expected: Approximately 5,000 records processed within 120 seconds in the defined environment; all records accounted for; normal API remains responsive. Report upload transfer time separately.

Title: Concurrent load and resource stability
Preconditions: Dedicated stack; seeded catalogue; workload profile from 3.1.5.
Steps: 1. Run 5, 20 and 50 client stages. 2. Capture latency/errors/CPU/memory/queue depth. 3. Observe recovery after load removal.
Expected: Expected-load stage meets agreed thresholds; no unexplained data loss or unbounded queue/memory growth; overload behavior and limits are reported.

Title: Upload boundaries and archive expansion
Preconditions: Files at configured limit minus 1 byte, exact limit and plus 1 byte; spoofed image; high-expansion ZIP; many entries.
Steps: 1. Upload each boundary file. 2. Submit spoofed image and expanded-size archive. 3. Monitor process memory and persisted results.
Expected: Valid limits follow configuration; invalid/oversize content rejected; expanded-byte/entry budget stops unsafe work; no unexpected server crash. Record actual configured limits before execution.

Title: Build, configuration and browser smoke
Preconditions: Locked dependencies; example configuration; selected browsers.
Steps: 1. Build all workspaces. 2. Validate Compose without printing secrets. 3. Verify CORS, image URLs, HTTPS in deployment and nested routes. 4. Record browser versions.
Expected: Every selected environment builds and completes smoke flows; secrets remain outside browser output/logs. Build portion passed; remaining checks not executed.

Title: Search relevance and fallback quality
Preconditions: Twenty manually judged queries; exact/typo/natural-language/no-match fixtures; catalogue over 300 records.
Steps: 1. Record expected matches before execution. 2. Search in provider-enabled and fallback modes. 3. Inspect top five and sorted results.
Expected: Hard constraints always hold; expected exact matches remain retrievable; record precision@5 and misses. Proposed relevance target: expected known match in top five for at least 18/20 labelled queries; team approval pending.
